scope: Experimental1214o on 1214n (#14 multi-enemy combat): host-world damage (neither attacker nor inflictor is the local player, a player-owned entity or a world sentinel; take 1270e: bloodflies on a bound checkpoint guard were refused, its channel retired, and the host's next sword hits and the death went unshared) passes the host capture natively; the host commits its observed native loss as an ordered HostWorld commit and the client removes exactly that loss by the native health subtraction (health vtable +0xf8).
